app/Actions/CreateLink.php.name: Create short link
app/Actions/CreateLink.php.description: Saves a new short link for an owner, drawing a unique code when no alias is given.

app/Actions/RecordClick.php.name: Record a click
app/Actions/RecordClick.php.description: Stores that someone opened a short link, including rough device and browser info.

app/Actions/ResolveLink.php.name: Find short link
app/Actions/ResolveLink.php.description: Looks up a short code through the cache and returns the link if it still exists.

app/Actions/UpdateLink.php.name: Update short link
app/Actions/UpdateLink.php.description: Applies edits to a link and clears the cached copy so redirects stay correct.
